purpose: Teach a retrieval-based workflow for maintaining FAQ records

required_facts.fact: Proposals enter through a GitHub Issue form.
The agent indexes section, question and answer with minsearch.
Retrieved similar entries and metadata are sent with the proposal.
FAQDecision returns NEW, UPDATE or DUPLICATE.
The workflow can create or update files or close duplicates.
The bot can misclassify sections or merge targets.
Claude Code is used to review batches of pull requests.
The default triage model is gpt-5-nano.

author_attribution: Present this as Alexey's FAQ workflow and preserve the named contributors.
